name: Quantified aeolian dune changes on Mars from repeat Context Camera images
location: Nili Patera; Meroe Patera; West Herschel; East Herschel; Hellespontus Montes; McLaughlin

coordinate_reference_system.name: Product-specific Mars Equirectangular; each DTM tied to MOLA
coordinate_reference_system.co_registration_status: DTMs are not bundled into one simultaneous block adjustment; possible elevation steps must be checked.

limitations: The complete collection is about 1.43 GB across six sites; only a small Nili Patera subset is selected in this manifest.
Acquisition timestamps are not embedded in the ArcGIS .tif.xml sidecars and must be resolved from PDS labels or indexes.
DTMs are tied to MOLA individually and are not necessarily co-registered with each other; elevation steps and FOM quality must be inspected.
Published site-level rates and fluxes are aggregate context, not labels for individual dunes.
The six sites are separate dune fields and must not be split randomly across train and test.
A temporal baseline in Earth years does not establish that the surface change is steady or that every dune moved.

published_context.citation: Davis et al., Quantified Aeolian Dune Changes on Mars Derived From Repeat Context Camera Images, Earth and Space Science, 2020.

notes: Verified through the figshare API on 2026-11-14. The manifest selects one Nili Patera early/late CTX pair plus DEM and FOM. The remaining sites and products are referenced by article ID and must be inspected before download.
